the worst GP surgery you could wish to come across. From the Reception all the way up.
Reception team are horrid. Here's one interaction for a 5 year old child who had been taken out of school for an appointment:
Receptionist: "you will have to rebook",
Me:"can I rebook for next week?"
Receptionist: "Err, no. Because next week is boxing day".
Me: "What, all week?",
Receptionist: "well no I can get you in on Tuesday"
Me: "well I'll take that then please".
Receptionist: "Well I can only get you in at 11am",
Me: "but my child is at school, can't really take her out again, is there another time?
Receptionist: "Fine, 4.30 then."
Make that make sense. They really don't care how they inconvenience you. They are so abrupt and rude, and now all hidden in another room and you have to use a machine to sign in. If you make them come out there will be hell to pay. On another occasion, I used the machine, but was left waiting for 40 minutes - until I called one out to ask what was going on, they didn't even know I was there.

Then there's pesriptions. Doctor said it would be ready in 30 minutes. I went to the pharmacy next door, who said they hadn't sent anything over. So I went home and called the Doctors again. The Receptionist said it would be ready in another 30 minutes. I went an hour later and still hadn't been sent across. This was just today but has happened several times before.

Absolutely appalling place.",null,[0,176]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xsS1dYQkJNVEJRYldwTGVVcGxWVlY0YlRGSGFuYxAB!2m1!1s0x0:0xd410c16372d417ee!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOllKWXBBMTBQbWpLeUplVVV4bTFHanc%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xsS1dYQkJNVEJRYldwTGVVcGxWVlY0YlRGSGFuYxAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwjfk5z3lLCTAxVoMGMBHXZCCjcQoykIBygB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwjfk5z3lLCTAxVoMGMBHXZCCjcQ0pMFCAUoAQ"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBaHBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMUIzU1Vka1lsOWZSV2hDUTNCQ2REWkdSV1JvTjFveE5tVnRORUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpSYzBOWlgwRm5XakZ6V1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2t0amJUQnJSMWRyY204MkxYbzFlazVyZFRrNE0zYxAB",["0x0:0xd410c16372d417ee",null,1769025181993708,1769025181993708,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/109888170123074036023/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Scarlett Knowles","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJfNGd3qn-l-4JJzaFSnYz9iOW9bqlFgN-F1lbKf8CkMgCoAQ=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/109888170123074036023?hl=en"],"109888170123074036023",null,1,0,null,[0,1,1],0,["1 review",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwjfk5z3lLCTAxVoMGMBHXZCCjcQ7LoGCAkoAA"]]]],null,"a month ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[5],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Seen within 40 minutes of waiting for a checkup the reception was quiet,clean and kind.
